title: What Chaplaincy Is All About
description: Chaplains provide spiritual and emotional care in hospitals, hospices, the military, prisons, universities, and corporations. They serve people of all faiths and none, offering presence, counsel, ritual, and crisis support without proselytizing. Patients, families, and staff facing illness, grief, moral injury, or crisis. title: History and Evolution
description: Chaplaincy traces to military chaplains serving armies for centuries; the US has had military chaplains since 1775. Healthcare chaplaincy professionalized in the 20th century with CPE (1920s) and board certification, growing into an interfaith discipline. Knowing where the trade came from explains why things are done the way they are — and which 'rules' are just old habits.
key_points: History explains current practice.
Key point: Chaplaincy traces to military chaplains serving armies for centuries; the US has had military chaplains since 1775.

Tradition plus testing beats either alone.

description: Teaching is the fastest way to master the trade: explaining forces clarity. Start by mentoring one beginner, demonstrate slowly, correct kindly, and let them struggle productively before stepping in.
key_points: Teaching forces true clarity.
Demonstrate slowly; correct kindly.
Let beginners struggle productively.
Mentor one person to start.
how_it_works: Offer to show a beginner the basics.
Prepare a simple lesson plan.
Demonstrate, then watch and coach.
Ask what confused them and improve.

title: The Career Path and Advancement
